en.title: [Recruitment] 2026 Fall Semester MX-SPACE TA Recruitment
summary: The Department of Design Technology in the College of Software Convergence is recruiting 2 MX-SPACE TAs for the 2026 Fall semester
MX-SPACE TAs perform lab management and SW mentoring (Q&A) duties
Eligible applicants are current 3rd/4th-year students or higher for the 2026 Fall semester (part-time enrolled students (부분 등록생) are eligible)
The application period is until Friday, 2026.09.04, and applicants must fill out the attached application form and submit it to juheekang@inha.ac.kr
Selection is based on academic grades and mentoring availability; results will be notified individually
en.easyExplanation: This is a notice recruiting MX-SPACE TAs for the 2026 Fall semester from the Department of Design Technology. Current 3rd/4th-year students or higher (part-time enrolled students (부분 등록생) are eligible) can apply, and applications must be submitted by Friday, September 4, 2026 via email with the completed application form.
en.target: Current 3rd/4th-year students or higher enrolled for the 2026 Fall semester (part-time enrolled students (부분 등록생) are eligible)

originalContent:
소트웨어융합대학 디자인테크놀로지학과에서는 아래와 같이 2026-2학기 MX-SPACE TA를 모집하오니 많은 관심 바랍니다.
MX-SPACE TA는 학부 TA와는 다르게 SW멘토링(질의응답) 업무가 있으니 지원서에 본인이 멘토링 가능한 SW를 적어서 지원해주기 바랍니다.
(사용 SW 참고 : 유니티, 언리얼엔진, 마야, 블렌더, 포토샵, 일러스트레이터, C++, 파이썬, 자바 등)
